description: This file contains the S3UriParser class responsible for parsing and extracting information from Amazon S3 URIs, including handling path-style and virtual-hosted URLs, as well as stream wrapper URIs. It is used to interpret S3 resource identifiers into components like bucket, key, region, and path style.

classes.name: S3UriParser
classes.description: A class that provides methods to parse S3 URIs, extracting bucket, key, region, and style information, supporting various URI formats and schemas.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a given URI or stream wrapper URI into its components including bucket, key, region, and style.

methods.name: parseS3UrlComponents
methods.description: Helper method to extract scheme, host, and path components from an S3 URL string.

methods.name: parseStreamWrapper
methods.description: Handles parsing of s3 stream wrapper URIs into components.

methods.name: parseCustomEndpoint
methods.description: Parses URIs with custom endpoints to extract bucket and key.

methods.name: parsePathStyle
methods.description: Parses path-style S3 URLs to identify bucket and key.

methods.name: parseVirtualHosted
methods.description: Parses virtual-hosted S3 URLs to extract bucket and key.
